requirements.description: User wants the property near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area.

The user prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Energy class is used because the user did not mention consumption, and energy_score_class cannot separate D from E.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property type 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili', surface_area >= 115, energy_class from A1 to D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892). The 15-person capacity and the authorization question are not in the extracted requirements, so they add no predicate. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, nearest first.
